name: Milton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Milton, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Milton, Wisconsin for 2026: a lighted parade, Santa and tree lighting, Milton House tours and a tree display.
lede: Milton gathers its Christmas into Merry Milton Weekend, with a lighted parade, an afternoon with Santa and a community tree lighting, Milton House Museum tours and a festive forest of trees.
celebrates: The Open Doors Foundation presents Milton's Lighted Christmas Parade, which it calls a cherished holiday tradition that brings families together as illuminated floats, local businesses, schools and community groups light up the streets. The City of Milton's calendar places the parade on the first night of Merry Milton Weekend, followed by Santa and the community tree lighting at The Gathering Place. KANDU Industries adds a fundraising tree display, and the Milton House Museum offers Christmas twilight tours, so the weekend mixes free community events with a few ticketed ones.
lastyear: The City of Milton's calendar lists the 2025 Merry Milton Lighted Christmas Parade on Friday, December 5, 2025, in downtown Milton, with the route starting at Arthur Drive and St. Mary's Street. The same calendar and the Open Doors Foundation describe the parade as an annual event, and Open Doors calls the 2026 parade its fourth annual lighted parade.
facts: The Milton House Museum, at 18 South Janesville Street, is one of the town's best-known sites and takes part in Merry Milton Weekend. The Gathering Place is at 715 Campus Street, and the Open Doors Foundation says the tree lighting happens on its Green. The parade ends at North Goodrich Park, according to the Open Doors listing.
trains: Milton has no Christmas train of its own. The East Troy Railroad Museum, northeast of Milton, runs daytime and evening Christmas trains and a free Santa Parade Train, and our museum guide lists it. Milton families often pair a parade night with a train weekend.
train_links: Christmas trains and the Santa Parade Train, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Illuminated floats, schools and businesses travel Parkview Drive to North Goodrich Park.
Santa visits The Gathering Place before the community tree lighting.
The tree on The Gathering Place Green is lit as part of Merry Milton Weekend.
Christmas traditions twilight tours at the historic museum.
A tree display at KANDU Industries that raises money for its programs.
kidfact: Milton's parade floats are covered in lights, and the weekend ends with a tree that glows on the Green.
faq: Milton celebrates with Merry Milton Weekend. The weekend opens with the Lighted Christmas Parade, continues with an afternoon of Santa visits and a community tree lighting at The Gathering Place, and includes Milton House Museum tours and a tree display at KANDU Industries.
Where does the Milton Christmas parade go?
Open Doors lists the route as starting at Arthur Drive and St. Mary's Street, running down Parkview Drive and ending at North Goodrich Park. The parade is free to watch and runs in the evening.
Yes. The parade is a free community event presented by the Open Doors Foundation, with awards for floats and groups.
Where is the Milton tree lighting?
The community tree lighting is on The Gathering Place Green, at 715 Campus Street, after the afternoon with Santa.
Are there ticketed Christmas events in Milton?
Yes. The KANDU tree display sells tickets in advance through its fundraising page, and the Milton House Museum twilight tours are priced by the museum.
